A port of [hxrry27/PaperAccurateBlockPlacement](https://github.com/hxrry27/PaperAccurateBlockPlacement) (which only had a 26.2 build) to Minecraft 26.3. It lets Litematica's easyPlace and Tweakeroo's flexible/accurate block placement place blocks with the right states (facing, open/closed, hinge, repeater delay, comparator mode, slab/stair shape, ...) on Paper servers.

### Requirements
- Paper 26.3 (or a Paper fork such as Purpur), running on Java 25
- [packetevents](https://modrinth.com/plugin/packetevents) **2.14.0 or newer** in the `plugins` folder (2.14.0 is the first release with 26.3 support; older ones won't work on 26.3)

Install: drop `PaperAccurateBlockPlacement-1.5.0+mc26.3.jar` and the packetevents jar into `plugins/` and restart. Leave the config on `v3` and the Litematica/Tweakeroo protocol setting on `Auto`.

### Changes compared to the upstream 26.2 build
- Built against paper-api 26.3 and packetevents 2.14.0 (`api-version: 26.3`)
- Gradle 9.8.1 wrapper and a Java 25 toolchain (the old Gradle 8.10 wrapper couldn't build for Java 25)
- Fix: the plugin now registers on packetevents' shared instance and loads after packetevents. Before, it replaced that instance with its own, so whether placement packets reached the plugin depended on plugin load order, and other packetevents-based plugins could break
- Fix: `/abp` and `/abp reload` now work. Paper plugins can't declare commands in `paper-plugin.yml`, so the command was never registered ("Unknown or incomplete command"). Also adds tab completion and coloured replies

### Tested
- Compiles against paper-api `26.3.build.239-stable`
- Boot test in CI on Paper 26.3 build 239 with packetevents 2.14.0: the plugin enables (protocol v3), `/abp` and `/abp reload` work, no errors in the server log
- Not tested in CI: placing blocks from a real Litematica/Tweakeroo client. The placement protocol is unchanged between Litematica's 26.2 and 26.3 versions (same property list and bit layout), so the decoder logic is the same as in the working 26.2 build
